title: Love the layout and motivation
review: Enjoying the layout and motivation. Simple to navigate, keeps everything organized. Encourages consistency and accountability without being too complicated.

title: Disappointed and Charged
review: Filled profile, chose challenge, had me choose subscription. Charged before entering app. Expected more features for motivation. Felt under illusion there would be free trial. Charged card immediately.

title: Love it - keeps me accountable
review: Super simple, easy to use, keeps me accountable daily. Daily checklist without feeling overwhelmed. Progress builds up over time. Straightforward but effective.

title: Her 75 Challenge - amazing
review: Super easy to use, several challenges. Can add/remove/edit rules. Highly recommend.

title: Great Idea, Poor Execution
review: Right idea (mood board to cross off items) but very simple. Friend feature doesn't sync - I see her list but it doesn't update when she crosses items, can't see her photos. Paying $15/month for a glorified checklist. More than I've ever paid for a decent app subscription.

title: In my rebuilding era
review: Hard time staying accountable. Downloaded today, love everything so far - easy to use, aesthetics amazing, can make friends. Surrounding yourself with people who want the same things helps.

title: Not what it seems
review: No chat with friends, no workout videos, no water log tracking (like shown in screenshots). Always glitching. Literally just a checklist with recipe ideas (almonds/bananas). Aesthetic with great potential but either unfinished or a scam. Not fair to pay $50 for unfinished app.

title: Getting My Life Back
review: Just started Her 75 Days challenge. App is super cute and helps motivating. Ready to put myself and health first.

title: ready to start!
review: Love the layout, simplicity, functionality. Excited to start my own custom challenge - more sustainable than following a pre-made one. Glad that option exists.

title: already excited to use this app
review: Downloaded and instantly bought the plan. Love the features offered, app is aesthetically pleasing and easy to use.
